context: Evaluates correct use of the dynamic user prompt generator from open-nof1.ai. The solution must import and call generateUserPrompt with a UserPromptOptions object containing formatted market state, account performance strings, a start time Date, and optional invocation count, and correctly use the resulting prompt string.

checklist.name: Correct import and call
checklist.description: The solution correctly imports generateUserPrompt from open-nof1.ai (lib/ai/prompt.ts) and calls it with a UserPromptOptions object

checklist.name: Market state inclusion
checklist.description: The options object includes currentMarketState as a string (typically produced by formatMarketState) and the generated prompt incorporates this data

checklist.name: Account performance inclusion
checklist.description: The options object includes accountInformationAndPerformance as a string (typically produced by formatAccountPerformance) and the generated prompt incorporates this data

checklist.name: startTime parameter
checklist.description: The options object correctly includes a startTime Date object representing the beginning of the trading session

checklist.name: invocationCount parameter
checklist.description: The optional invocationCount parameter is correctly passed when available (number of times trading bot has been invoked)
